title: 그래도
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The Korean Basic Dictionary records **그래도** as a contraction of 그리하여도/그러하여도 and gives examples where a prior circumstance is acknowledged but the following decision or judgment remains. This entry is limited to those attested concessive examples.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). 그래도. In *Korean Basic Dictionary*. National Institute of Korean Language. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=36264&nation=eng

Korean Basic Dictionary, entry 그래도, senses 1–2 and examples including “그래도 이번에는 나도 어쩔 수가 없어.”

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **하지만**, **그런데** y **-지만**, todos capaces de expresar oposición en distintos contextos. Se distingue de **그래서**, que introduce normalmente una consecuencia, no una concesión.
